title: λ/4 阻抗变换器：让 50 Ω 线带 200 Ω 负载
statement: 信号源 V̇_s = 10∠0° V（有效值），R_s = 50 Ω，f = 300 MHz，经 1 m 长的 50 Ω 无损耗主线向 R_L = 200 Ω 供电。为了消除主线上的反射，在 a 点与负载之间串入一段特性阻抗为 Z_c1、长 l_1 的无损耗线（两段线的相速都是 2×10⁸ m/s）。
设计 Z_c1 和最短的 l_1，使主线匹配。x 从各段的始端量起。

questions.ask: λ/4 匹配段的特性阻抗 Z_c1 = ?
questions.explain: λ/4 线的输入阻抗 Z_in = Z_c1²/R_L。要 Z_in = 50 Ω：Z_c1 = √(50 × 200) = 100 Ω。

questions.ask: 匹配段的最短长度 l_1 = ?
从 a 点向负载看进去的阻抗（实部）= ?
questions.explain: 100²/200 = 50 Ω，纯电阻，等于主线的 Z_c。

questions.ask: 主线（50 Ω 线）上的驻波比 = ?
questions.explain: 主线终端接的是 50 Ω（匹配），Γ = 0，VSWR = 1：主线上只有行波。
全部匹配，电源输出最大功率 V_s²/(4R_s) = 100/200 = 0.5 W，无损耗线把它全部送到 R_L。

questions.ask: 频率变为 450 MHz（各段线长不变）时，主线上的驻波比 = ?

hints: λ/4 线有什么特点？把 βl = π/2 代入输入阻抗公式。
Z_in = Z_c1²/Z_L 是纯电阻的条件是 Z_L 为纯电阻；让它等于主线的 Z_c。
频率改变时 βl_1 不再是 90°，用一般的输入阻抗公式重新算 a 点的阻抗和主线的 Γ。
solution: **3. 结果。** a 点阻抗 **50 Ω**，主线 Γ = 0，**VSWR = 1**；电源送出 **0.5 W**（最大功率），全部到达 R_L。匹配段上仍有驻波（VSWR = 2），但很短。
**检查：** Z_c1 是 Z_c 与 R_L 的几何平均：50 < 100 < 200 ✓。

en.title: Quarter-wave transformer: a 50 Ω line feeding a 200 Ω load
statement: A source V̇_s = 10∠0° V (rms), R_s = 50 Ω, f = 300 MHz feeds R_L = 200 Ω through a 1 m long 50 Ω lossless main line. To remove the reflection on the main line, a lossless section with characteristic impedance Z_c1 and length l_1 is inserted between point a and the load (both lines have phase velocity 2×10⁸ m/s).
Design Z_c1 and the shortest l_1 so that the main line is matched. x is measured from the start of each line.

questions.ask: Characteristic impedance of the λ/4 matching section Z_c1 = ?
questions.explain: The input impedance of a λ/4 line is Z_in = Z_c1²/R_L. For Z_in = 50 Ω: Z_c1 = √(50 × 200) = 100 Ω.

questions.ask: Shortest length of the matching section l_1 = ?
Impedance seen at a looking towards the load (real part) = ?
questions.explain: 100²/200 = 50 Ω, purely resistive and equal to the main line's Z_c.

questions.ask: Standing-wave ratio on the main (50 Ω) line = ?
questions.explain: The main line now ends in 50 Ω (matched): Γ = 0, VSWR = 1 — only a travelling wave on the main line.
Everything is matched: the source delivers its maximum V_s²/(4R_s) = 100/200 = 0.5 W and the lossless lines pass all of it to R_L.

questions.ask: At 450 MHz (same lengths), the standing-wave ratio on the main line = ?
questions.explain: Now the section is 3λ/8 long, tan βl_1 = −1: Z_in = 100 × (200 − j100)/(100 − j200) = (80 + j60) Ω, |Γ| = |(30 + j60)/(130 + j60)| = 0.4685, VSWR = 2.76 — a quarter-wave transformer matches only near its design frequency.

hints: What is special about a λ/4 line? Put βl = π/2 into the input-impedance formula.
Z_in = Z_c1²/Z_L is resistive when Z_L is; make it equal to the main line's Z_c.
At another frequency βl_1 is no longer 90°: use the general input-impedance formula again for the impedance at a and Γ on the main line.
solution: **1. Matching condition.** For βl_1 = π/2, tan βl_1 → ∞ and Z_in = Z_c1²/R_L; set it to 50 Ω: **Z_c1 = √(50 × 200) = 100 Ω**.

**3. Result.** The impedance at a is **50 Ω**, Γ = 0 on the main line, **VSWR = 1**; the source delivers **0.5 W** (its maximum), all of it reaching R_L. The section itself still carries a standing wave (VSWR = 2), but it is short.
**4. Bandwidth.** At 450 MHz βl_1 = 135°: Z_in = (80 + j60) Ω and the main-line VSWR is **2.76**.
**Check:** Z_c1 is the geometric mean of Z_c and R_L: 50 < 100 < 200 ✓.
